name: Splat and Replace
definition: A method that improves novel view synthesis in scenes with repetitive elements by segmenting each repeated instance in a 3DGS reconstruction, registering them together, and allowing information to be shared among instances to improve geometry and account for appearance variations.
summary: Splat and Replace enhances novel view synthesis in repetitive scenes by fusing segmented instances into a shared template, improving geometry in occluded regions.
